_comment: The route behind the first-service vlog (public/mygarage/vlog/config/first-service-dharapuram.json → rideId 'r6'). Field notes live in src/data/rides.js.
_todo: time     — what the ride actually took, as a QUOTED clock, H:MM ('1:15').
Unquoted 1:15 is invalid JSON and takes the whole garage down.
Leave it null and the detail page shows the router's estimate
instead, which is 56 mins for these stops.
rating / stats / photos — fill in as you like; null and [] are fine.
COORDINATES are geocoded from OpenStreetMap, not guessed: Kangeyam town
and the Avinashipalayam village node in Tiruppur South (638660). The two
exceptions are Kariya Kattu Valasu and the showroom, which keep the values
already authored in r1 — OSM has no node for Senthur Motors, and r1 is the
same trip in the other direction, so the pins must agree.
DISTANCE is the router's figure for this exact chain (54.2 km), not an
odometer reading. 'completed' rides are what the garage totals are summed
from, so correct it if the trip meter disagreed.
name: Home to Dharapuram — First Service
subtitle: Kariya Kattu Valasu → Kangayam → Avinashipalayam → Royal Enfield Senthur Motors, Dharapuram
description: Back to the showroom the Bear came from, for its first service.
story: The first service run — out of Kariya Kattu Valasu through Kangayam and Avinashipalayam, and down to Senthur Motors at Dharapuram, the same showroom the bike was delivered from. The delivery ride came the other way up this road on day one.
